summary: Authored exactly the assigned Career World geography and five illustrative employer capitals as six unique deterministic 2.5D SVG geometry definitions. Tier 0 retains the complete coastline/district or capital exterior identity; tiers 1 and 2 add only interior cartography, seams, windows, and rails. All definitions use the frozen projection, orientation zero, canonical palette slots, conservative footprints, and literal primary/master hashes independently recomputed from the F0 serializer. G0 binds the Director-corrected F0 predecessor envelope and promoted 56-asset art report, but does not claim integration, placement, promotion, or Director acceptance.
